architecture.saved_actor_contract: Four Pacuare-only actors share RaftSimPacuareHumidAtmosphereV1: one movable atmosphere sun, one captured sky fill, one physical SkyAtmosphere aerial-perspective actor, and one layered exponential-height-fog actor.
architecture.sky_transport: The Pacuare SkyAtmosphere uses multi-scattering 1.08, Mie scattering scale 0.0048, anisotropy 0.72, and exponential distribution 0.90. The sky fill is 1.90 and the fog color is [0.58, 0.68, 0.60].
architecture.layered_humidity: The non-volumetric height fog uses density 0.0075, height falloff 0.18, maximum opacity 0.62, and a 450 cm start distance. Its restrained water-level layer uses density 0.0012, -160 cm height offset, and 0.06 falloff.
architecture.runtime_state_stream_guard: The committed map serializes the reviewed values. UE 5.8 PIE world duplication replays a stale exponential-fog state-stream value after ordinary actor ticks, so the Pacuare water-config actor alone reasserts the tagged presentation fields in TG_PostUpdateWork. Every other river leaves this tick disabled.
architecture.authority_boundary: All humidity actors and the runtime guard are presentation-only. They do not modify Landscape samples, collision, cooked fields, wet/dry topology, bathymetry, solver state, water geometry, buoyancy, raft forces, routing, or scoring.

rejected_iterations.policy: No rejected volumetric frame is retained as current evidence.
rejected_iterations.reason: All three volumetric candidates increased dark canopy occlusion and/or far-field contrast. The last rejected guide frame had bank mean luminance 0.147233 and near-black fraction 0.344385 versus baseline 0.172255 and 0.269913 under the earlier fixed region; the last rejected river-eye frame measured 0.176094 and 0.298849 versus 0.199945 and 0.221857.
rejected_iterations.retained_direction: Use physical sky scattering plus two non-volumetric exponential layers; do not use translucent mist cards or volumetric fog for this Pacuare pass.

matched_capture_metrics.bank_region: Concatenated left and right banks: y 24%-66%, x 0%-30% and 70%-100%.
matched_capture_metrics.verdict: Retain as a bounded humidity and shadow-readability improvement. All views are brighter, bank near-black coverage falls 37.47%-44.38%, and the distant opening reads as humid air rather than an opaque mist card. Far-region standard deviation rises with the brighter sky opening, so this is not claimed as a full distance-contrast or photoreal pass.

remaining_photoreal_defects: Canopy, understory, shrubs, and ground cover remain project-owned procedural fallback rather than approved Pacuare species assets.
The 1009x1009 reach-local terrain is too coarse for credible bank microtopography, roots, leaf litter, wet soils, and rock-scale geology.
The river surface still lacks production refraction, reflection, sediment response, subsurface depth cues, caustics, and contact wetness.
Whitewater remains thin and lacks calibrated crest thickness, rollers, holes, spray, aerosol, and rock-contact plume volume.
No production rain, cloud, wind, moving canopy, seasonal lighting, or time-of-day system is present.
Upper Huacas hydraulics remain unconverged and are not calibrated to observed discharge, bathymetry, hazards, or guide lines.
The retained atmosphere has not passed guide, ecology, environment-art, desktop-performance, or VR-performance approval.

photoreal water/VFX plus raft, equipment, character, animation, and occlusion approval
